title: 霸王龙的大嗓门
subtitle: 声音太大，朋友会跑开
character: wearing a red t-shirt, khaki shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream

pages.zh:
我最喜欢学霸王龙。
「吼——！」
声音好大。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing on a lawn with both hands raised like claws, his mouth wide open, shouting, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
我一吼，
旁边的小朋友
往后退了一步。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, shouting with raised hands while another child takes a step back, hands over their own ears, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
他们走开了。
我一个人吼，
没有人陪我。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing alone on the lawn with his hands down, looking at the empty grass, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
爸爸说：
「霸王龙很厉害，
可是朋友的耳朵很软。」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting on the grass with his father, who points gently at his own ear, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
爸爸教我三个声音。
小声：说悄悄话。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, leaning close to his father and whispering, one hand beside his mouth, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
中声：一起玩的时候。
「我们来玩恐龙。」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, talking normally to his father on the grass, both sitting, a toy dinosaur between them, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
大声：在外面喊，
或者有危险的时候。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing on the lawn calling out with both hands around his mouth, his father watching, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
我试了一遍。
爸爸说中声最好听。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing on the grass talking to his father, his hands relaxed at his sides, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
第二天，我用中声说：
「我们来玩恐龙好吗？」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, talking to another child on the lawn, holding a toy dinosaur out towards them, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
他们没有跑开。
有一个还问：
「我当谁？」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing with two children on the lawn, all three holding toy dinosaurs, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
我们一起当霸王龙，
一起吼了一声。
这回大家都在笑。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing with two children, all with hands raised like claws, mouths open, everyone laughing, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.

pages.zh:
吼可以，
先问一句：
「我们一起吼好吗？」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing on the lawn with a toy dinosaur, looking at the viewer, smiling, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, thick gouache with visible brush strokes and flat shapes, deep red, olive green and warm cream.
